$comment: INERT planning example. Not registered, not loaded, not wired into any code. A complete, plausible PluginManifest for a FUTURE GitHub integration plugin, mirroring the marketplace contract (crates/server/src/plugins/manifest.rs). Field names stay English (marketplace surface); host PROJECTUS domain identifiers (tarefa, projeto, titulo, atualizado_em) are untouched.
title: GitHub
short_description: Link issues and pull requests to projects and tasks, with live status badges.
long_description: GitHub connects your PROJECTUS projeto and tarefa items to repositories, issues and pull requests. Paste a GitHub URL onto a tarefa to attach it and show a live status badge (open / merged / closed) on the task card; link a projeto to a repo to surface its open issues in a routed screen. OAuth tokens are kept in the host secret store, all calls go out over the network, and a background job refreshes statuses on a timer so badges stay current without manual reloads. A command-palette provider lets you search and attach issues without leaving the keyboard.
author: PROJECTUS Labs
changelog:
0.9.0 - Background status refresh and PR badges.
0.8.0 - Attach issues to tasks.
0.7.0 - OAuth via host secret store.
